text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Urara-san... please reconsider.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's fine! I don't really get 
it, but I'm sure they're a nice person!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You see, the Prez told me to go meet 
someone I don't know!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Even if it's through the Student 
Council, going without knowing the details 
means you won't know what to do if 
something goes wrong, right?
choice_data_list: That is a concern, I'll go with Urara.

It certainly is a concern, I'll accompany 
Urara.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay, okay! Let's go, let's go! Ayabe-san, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wait... why am I coming too――

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
――And so! We would be thrilled to have 
Urara-san grace the poster for our ryokan!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
I saw the Horse Girl Karuta Tournament on 
TV! Your strong, radiant performance... It 
fits the image of our inn perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Woohoo, hooray! Of course, Urara will 
do her very best!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
! In that case, I'd really love to have 
that last-minute participant join in as 
well...!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there was a student who jumped in 
during the second half of the tournament, 
possessing such a dignified, noble 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
Let me see... She looked just like... like 
the person standing... over there...

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah... It's you, isn't it?! What a 
miracle! Would you please consider taking 
part in our poster shoot...?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —I decline.

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text: !! ...I, I see. ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehh? Why, why not? Come join us, 
Ayabe-san! It'll be super-duper fun!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... ............There are plenty of 
girls far more suited than me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Someone who brightens people's moods just 
by looking at them. Featuring a cheerful 
girl like that will draw far more 
customers. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text: Th-That is—

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text: How truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
Making a judgment while keeping our 
business interests in mind! Such 
consideration, such integrity...!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
What captivated me so during that 
tournament— was none other than your 
sincere, earnest profile as you faced the 
match! Your cooperation would be the true 
catalyst for our success!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
So please, somehow...! Would you 
reconsider your decision once more...?!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
Of course, we will do everything in our 
power to ensure it won't interfere with 
your races or training in any way...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Even if you say that............
choice_data_list: Why not give it another thought?

I'm looking forward to seeing the finished 
poster!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Not you too............ Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Then Ayabe-san is coming too~! Yay! I get 
to go with Ayabe-san~♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What should we do at the inn? Umm, I 
wonder what they have~...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I know! Hot springs! They had hot springs, 
right?! Let's go in together! Hot springs, 
hot spriiiings~♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Urara-san, this isn't about going on a 
leisure trip, you know.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ayabe-san, you're not going into the 
hot springs...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No... That's not it, I'm not saying I 
won't go in, either—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Right! You're going in♪ Let's go splash 
right in together!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Urara-san... That's why I'm saying—

And so, Admire Vega ended up agreeing to 
model for the poster.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It'll be totally okay! I'm right by your 
side! You can definitely do it!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Like I said, it's not that I hate doing 
it or anything...

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
In that case, please! The aura you 
project, Ayabe-san, or rather, your 
uniquely dignified charm— we simply must 
capture it in our poster!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
You embody our inn's motto of 'Sincere 
Service to Guests' to the absolute 
fullest! I have mountains of other reasons 
to ask you as well!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... All right, all right already. 
...Fine.

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text: —Which means...?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I'll accept. Even though I don't think 
I warrant that much expectation.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Don't just run with the conversation on 
your own... And I don't need transparent 
flattery, either.

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! That attitude right there is 
your greatest charm, and I believe it will 
create a poster that moves countless 
hearts!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm saying...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Pick me, pick me! I know tons of cool 
things about Ayabe-san too! Just the other 
day, she was running on the track and—

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! I guarantee the poster will turn 
out magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Fine, I get it already! Enough, 
please...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I'll take the job. It feels like 
refusing... will just be more of a hassle.
